The first replacement authentication returned HTTP 502; a later retry returned HTTP 200. No fixed propagation delay or underlying failure cause is inferred.
After retiring the original public key, saved the unchanged OpenLaw connector to invalidate its cached driver and verified a fresh connection test returned HTTP 200 for the intended account.
limitations: No Envelope has been sent and no Signer inbox has been used. Recipient authorization is pending.
